items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: No, the only time I backed Cab was when he was booked into a club where I was the house band.

ctx.x: reading that -- maybe it was one of the theater dates you did in New York with -- did you back Cab Calloway or you had some -- there was something I discovered, maybe on some recording date or something. Do you recall anything with Cab Calloway?
No, the only time I backed Cab was when he was booked into a club where I was the house band. And --
Huh. Maybe that's it. He was on the bill.
